tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Model Campaign
tool.description: run reviewed structural or magnetic model starts with bounded resources
tool.command: touch '$result_bundle' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$result_bundle' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && python /opt/radar-symmetry/ndip_model_campaign.py '$action' '$source_gpx' '$model_assets' '$model_request' worker '$result_bundle' > '$console_output' 2>&1

param.name: action
param.label: Reviewed model operation
param.option: Run a finite chunk of approved starts

tool.help: NOVA captures the exact source GPX, candidate catalog and approved finite search. Each independent start runs in a fresh process. The pool respects GALAXY_SLOTS, memory and container CPU quotas; absent allocation information permits one worker. Unstarted trials remain pending at the chunk deadline. Every result retains its disposition, source and protocol hashes. Only independently audited, qualified projects appear in the output collection. A low Rwp does not establish a structure. No model API credential, Galaxy key, Python script or network request is accepted as an input. Discovery and planning run separately in NOVA.
